description: This file is a PHPUnit test case for testing the EmailSubscriberDao class within the OrangeHRM admin plugin. It contains setup code, multiple test methods for CRUD operations, and uses test fixtures. It validates functionality related to email subscriber management.

classes.name: EmailSubscriberDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class for testing the EmailSubscriberDao, covering CRUD operations and data validation.

methods.description: Tests retrieving a list of email subscribers filtered by subscription ID.

methods.name: testGetEmailSubscriberById
methods.description: Tests retrieving a single email subscriber by ID and verifies its properties.
